lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar har guroo dhiaaidaa vadee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Great is the greatness of the Guru, who meditates on the Lord within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਘਟਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tus ditee poorai satiguroo ghatai naahee ik til kisai dee ghataaee ||
lines.translation: By His Pleasure, the Lord has bestowed this upon the Perfect True Guru; it is not diminished one bit by anyone's efforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਭ ਲੋੁਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saahib satiguroo kai val hai taa(n) jhakh jhakh marai sabh loukaaee ||
lines.translation: The True Lord and Master is on the side of the True Guru; and so, all those who oppose Him waste away to death in anger, envy and conflict.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dakaa ke muh kaale kare har karatai aap vadhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Creator, blackens the faces of the slanderers, and increases the glory of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu ni(n)dak ni(n)d karahi tiu tiu nit nit chaRai savaaee ||
lines.translation: As the slanderers spread their slander, so does the Guru's glory increase day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਆਣਿ ਸਭ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa tin pairee aan sabh paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak worships the Lord, who makes everyone fall at His Feet. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਣਤ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur setee ganat j rakhai halat palat sabh tis kaa gaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who enters into a calculated relationship with the True Guru loses everything, this world and the next.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਝਹੀਆ ਪਾਏ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟੇ ਝਖਦਾ ਝਖਦਾ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit jhaheeaa paae jhagoo sute jhakhadaa jhakhadaa jhaR paiaa ||
lines.translation: He grinds his teeth continually and foams at the mouth; screaming in anger, he perishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਉਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit upaav karai maaiaa dhan kaaran agalaa dhan bhee ud gaiaa ||
lines.translation: He continually chases after Maya and wealth, but even his own wealth flies away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ohu khate kiaa ohu khaavai jis a(n)dar sahasaa dukh paiaa ||
lines.translation: What shall he earn, and what shall he eat? Within his heart, there is only cynicism and pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਜਗਤੈ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: niravairai naal j vair rachaae sabh paap jagatai kaa tin sir laiaa ||
lines.translation: One who hates the One who has no hatred, shall bear the load of all the sins of the world on his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੁਹਿ ਅੰਬੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: os agai pichhai dhoee naahee jis a(n)dar ni(n)daa muhi a(n)b paiaa ||
lines.translation: He shall find no shelter here or hereafter; his mouth blisters with the slander in his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਨੋ ਓਹੁ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਖੇਹੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: je suine no ohu hath paae taa khehoo setee ral gaiaa ||
lines.translation: If gold comes into his hands, it turns to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: je gur kee saranee phir ohu aavai taa pichhale augan bakhas laiaa ||
lines.translation: But if he should come again to the Sanctuary of the Guru, then even his past sins shall be forgiven.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak anadin naam dhiaaiaa har simarat kilavikh paap gaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, night and day. Remembering the Lord in meditation, wickedness and sins are erased. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੂ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: toohai sachaa sach too sabh doo upar too deebaan ||
lines.translation: You are the Truest of the True; Your Regal Court is the most exalted of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh sach dhiaaide sach sevan sache teraa maan ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on You, O True Lord, serve the Truth; O True Lord, they take pride in You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa a(n)dar sach mukh ujale sach bolan sache teraa taan ||
lines.translation: Within them is the Truth; their faces are radiant, and they speak the Truth. O True Lord, You are their strength.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: se bhagat jinee guramukh saalaahiaa sach sabad neesaan ||
lines.translation: Those who, as Gurmukh, praise You are Your devotees; they have the insignia and the banner of the Shabad, the True Word of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sach j sache sevade tin vaaree sad kurabaan ||13||
lines.translation: I am truly a sacrifice, forever devoted to those who serve the True Lord. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਈ ਹੁਣਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur maare poorai satiguroo seee hun satigur maare ||
lines.translation: Those who were cursed by the Perfect True Guru, from the very beginning, are even now cursed by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਮੇਲਣ ਨੋ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je melan no bahuteraa locheeai na deee milan karataare ||
lines.translation: Even though they may have a great longing to associate with the Guru, the Creator does not allow it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat dhoee naa lahan vich sa(n)gat gur veechaare ||
lines.translation: They shall not find shelter in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; in the Sangat, the Guru has proclaimed this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੁਣਿ ਓਨਾ ਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee jaai milai hun onaa no tis maare jam ja(n)daare ||
lines.translation: Whoever goes out to meet them now, will be destroyed by the tyrant, the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਬਾਬੈ ਫਿਟਕੇ ਸੇ ਫਿਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur baabai phitake se phite gur a(n)gad keete kooRiaare ||
lines.translation: Those who were condemned by Guru Nanak were declared counterfeit by Guru Angad as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੀਜੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਏਨਾ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur teejee peeRee veechaariaa kiaa hath enaa vechaare ||
lines.translation: The Guru of the third generation thought, "What lies in the hands of these poor people?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚਉਥੀ ਪੀੜੀ ਟਿਕਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur chauthee peeRee tikiaa tin ni(n)dak dusat sabh taare ||
lines.translation: The Guru of the fourth generation saved all these slanderers and evil-doers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee put sikh sevaa kare satiguroo kee tis kaaraj sabh savaare ||
lines.translation: If any son or Sikh serves the True Guru, then all of his affairs will be resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਖੜਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so phal paaisee put dhan lakhamee khaR mele har nisataare ||
lines.translation: He obtains the fruits of his desires - children, wealth, property, union with the Lord and emancipation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nidhaan satiguroo vich jis a(n)dar har ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so paae pooraa satiguroo jis likhiaa likhat lilaare ||
lines.translation: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak maagai dhooR tin jo gurasikh mit piaare ||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those GurSikhs who love the Lord, their Friend. ||1||
